ns2:section.sectionText: Heritage Tour and Site Workshop in India Traveling from January 1-14 2014. Students will tour World Heritage Sites including the Taj Mahal and contemporary landscapes in New Delhi, Agra, and Jaupur. In addition they are required to participate in a site workshop on the ghats on the Ganga River in the holy city of Varanasi. The workshop will entail fieldwork and developing site plans for conservation and management of the riverfront. It will be the springboard for LA 336/438 Studio in Spring.
